name: frappe-syntax-query-builder
description: Use when building database queries with frappe.qb in Frappe v14-v16. Covers the PyPika-based query builder: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, joins, aggregation, subqueries, cross-DB compatibility (MariaDB/PostgreSQL), and migration from raw SQL. Prevents SQL injection and DB-specific bugs. Keywords: frappe.qb, query builder, DocType, Field, pypika, join,, frappe.qb example, how to write query, join tables, SQL replacement, parameterized query. aggregate, ImportMapper, cross-database, parameterized query.
